summary: The scoped synthetic shared-controller acceptance task is implementable and has explicit exact-SHA, privacy, and Human Approval boundaries. Recruitment taxonomy and localized product UX are not applicable and are not claimed as validated.

checks.name: trusted_planning_handoff
checks.detail: Task, PR, phase, source SHA, success status, and empty blockers match the supplied trusted handoff.

checks.name: implementation_scope
checks.detail: The synthetic marker, required phase sequence, SHA-bound evidence, and Human Approval terminal state are specified.

checks.name: privacy_and_synthetic_data
checks.detail: The plan requires synthetic-only data and excludes production candidate data, merge, and deployment.

checks.name: recruitment_taxonomy_and_aliases
checks.detail: No recruitment classifier or Khmer occupation terms/aliases are in scope; none are approved by this gate.

checks.name: multilingual_recruitment_ux
checks.detail: No recruitment-facing UI or localized product copy is proposed.

checks.name: workflow_terminal_safety
checks.detail: The task stops at Human Approval, retains the production-required approval state, and does not merge or deploy.

constraints: The marker file must contain exactly AGENT_E2E_OK with no trailing newline.
Bind each handoff and evidence record to GH-ISSUE-86, PR #87, and its exact source SHA.
After any HEAD change, obtain fresh evidence for that SHA; after QA report publication, follow the specified CI, independent review, and evidence-only QA sequence.
Use the approved shared-control host adapter and native shared-writer report publication; never fall back to legacy workflow-state writes.
Stop at Human Approval; do not merge or deploy.
